subject: Luka Modric
title: Modric, 41, still refusing to retire

lines.vo: Luka Modric is forty-one and has declined retirement again.
lines.footage: Modric Milan training, close-up, neutral lighting

lines.vo: Croatia's captain just won his 208th cap. That puts him level with Messi.
Croatia had lost four in a row, a first ever. Then they beat Czechia two-one in Osijek.
Only Cristiano Ronaldo has more, with two hundred and thirty-four. Modric played all ninety as captain. Cristiano, check your mirrors.
Since August, he has played nineteen of twenty-one matches. The calendar wants a rest. He does not.
He reached fifty Milan appearances in a two-one win at Genoa. Still no goodbye in sight.
Next up is Frosinone, his 227th different opponent, says Gazzetta. At this rate he will have played everyone.
lines.footage: Milan San Siro, stadium wide shot

lines.vo: Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.

inserts.story: A cartoon retirement party has balloons and a cake that reads goodbye Luka. A caricature Modric walks in, slices the cake, and passes a piece to every guest with the outside of his boot. Then he leaves for training, and the banner quietly flips to see you tomorrow.
inserts.characters: caricature Modric (small, neat midfielder); generic cartoon party guests; no real people

inserts.story: A cartoon dressing-room scoreboard shows 208 caps. A generic cartoon rival in a shirt numbered 234 waves from the far end. A caricature Modric waves back, and the scoreboard flips to 209 while he is still waving.
inserts.characters: caricature Modric; generic cartoon rival in a numbered shirt; no real people

inserts.story: A cartoon calendar flips its pages so fast it sheds confetti. A caricature Modric packs a tiny suitcase labelled retire. The calendar stamps Frosinone on the next page, and he sits on the suitcase to tie his boots.
inserts.characters: caricature Modric; generic cartoon calendar with a face; no real people

facts_used: 208th cap in 2-1 win over Czechia in Osijek; level with Messi; only Ronaldo (234) has more; Croatia ended a first-ever four-match losing streak (https://www.croatiaweek.com/croatia-beat-czechia-modric-equals-messi-record/)

19 of 21 matches since August across club and country, 1,114 minutes; Frosinone will be his 227th different opponent (Gazzetta via Milan Reports) (https://milanreports.com/2026/11/20/modric-croatia-milan-always-there/)
50 Milan appearances after a 2-1 win at Genoa (https://milanreports.com/2026/11/09/modric-50-appearances-ac-milan-at-41/)
Played full 90 minutes as captain in Osijek (research pack roast_now; source per croatiaweek item above)
notes: The 227th opponent count differs by outlet (155 club plus 71 or 72 Croatia), so it is approximate; say 'his 227th different opponent, according to Gazzetta' if the script is read closely. Retirement jokes are kept friendly. No injury, family, legal or illness material; the 2018 perjury case and the Milan minute for Ferencvaros conflict in sources and are not used. after_line counts from 1. Punch-up pass: the age joke is only about the calendar and caps, never about his body. 'Check your mirrors' is a friendly tease of the cap record. Keep 'says Gazzetta' on air for the 227th-opponent count.
